Stop-checking sheet: 20 moments from real White Mountains hikes

Your job: for each card, decide whether the hiker actually stopped (stood or sat still) during the shaded time. About a minute per card; don't overthink it.
  • Stopped: the colored dots on the right bunch up in one small blob, about the size of the dashed 10 m circle or smaller, and don't make progress along the trail. Dots jiggling back and forth is GPS noise, not walking.
  • Moving slowly: the colored dots march along the trail in one direction, even if slowly (steep climbs, scrambles, deep snow). "Net move" well above ~15 m is a strong hint.
  • Can't tell: mixed, confusing, or looks like a GPS glitch.
The sheet doesn't say which rule flagged each moment. That's deliberate, so your judgment is independent. When you're done, copy the line at the bottom and paste it to Claude.
